objective: Build ICF-04 Herbs, Spices, Fungi & Wild Forage against the verified ICF-02 schema and ICF-03 content conventions, preserving source-backed Agriculture/Alchemy terms while adding a substantial governed-first-party mundane baseline and deferring overtly magical/exotic source content to ICF-06.
implementation_decisions: 242 primary ingredient definitions are represented by a compact canonical source plus deterministic materializer.
233 records are governed-first-party mundane baseline content; 9 are hybrid/source-backed.
Redleaf and Soothewort preserve Alchemy Common Herb rarity and Healing Potion formula participation without individual healing-effect attribution.
Rockroot preserves Alchemy Uncommon Ingredient rarity and formula participation without attributing the Elixir of Giant Strength effect to Rockroot alone.

Agriculture source outputs Medicinal Herbs, Wild Berries, Mushrooms, Water Plants, Medicinal Plants and Snow Moss are preserved as generic source-backed definitions where the source does not identify a species.
Glow Mushrooms, Exotic Fruits, Ice Herbs, Mana-Infused Herbs, Lumina Berries, Fire Blossom, Dream Moss, Moonflower, Ironroot, Iceleaf and Etherleaf remain deferred to protected ICF-06.
MIB-13 retains current price/market scarcity; D17 retains live quantity/quality/condition/ownership; MIB-11 retains World/Reality/location identity.
No first-party medicinal or alchemical mechanical effect is inferred from real-world or folkloric association.
completion_gate: A substantial schema-conformant 242-record herb/spice/fungi/wild-forage library preserves source provenance and ICF-06 boundaries, passes deterministic library checks and AIOC repository health, and introduces no universal prices, live-state authority, unsupported magical properties, creature anatomy or inferred medicinal/alchemical effects.
